parse.title: Crimson Thief (Hunt)
parse.text:
Overview

Crimson Thief (Hunt) is a MythicalMythical based. He can only be obtained by evolving Crimson Thief.

Evolving

Crimson Thief (Hunt) can be evolved from Crimson Thief with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Crimson Thief
x12 Demonic Chalice
x12 Demonic Horn
x6 Fairy Petals
x12 Star Fruit
x4 Star Fruit (Red)
x3 Star Fruit (Pink)
x3 Star Fruit (Green)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Crimson Thief (Hunt)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
